1	"""Risk limits, halts and kill switch for the bot.
2	
3	Hard rules:
4	- refuse to signal when any input is stale (oracle > 5s, book > 10s)
5	- per-market position cap (shares and $)
6	- max concurrent markets with exposure
7	- a LADDER of halts (see below) ending in a daily kill switch
8	
9	Halt design. A halt exists to bound the loss when the EDGE ITSELF breaks
10	(the venue re-prices, a contract change, a corrupted feed) -- not to
11	punish ordinary variance. Every false trip costs the expected profit of
12	the hours it sits out, so the design goal is: trip fast on breakage,
13	almost never on noise.
14	
15	Measured on the live record (630 markets, 27.8h): aggregate daily sd is
16	roughly $590 at current caps, mostly btc. The original $200/coin daily
17	stop was ~1 sd of a btc day -- it tripped on 2026-08-12 on what the band
18	breakdown shows was variance plus one soft band, and the bot then sat out
19	six profitable hours. That is insurance priced above the risk it covers.
20	
21	The ladder, per coin process:
22	
23	1. STREAK BREAKER (breakage detector). At avg fill px ~0.92 the record's
24	   hit rate is ~0.95, so losses arrive ~1.6 per 20 settled markets.
25	   `streak_losses` (6) losses inside the last `streak_n` (20) settled
26	   markets has probability ~4e-3 per window under the healthy record --
27	   but is hit almost immediately when the edge actually inverts. Trips a
28	   `cooloff_s` (2h) pause, not a day kill: a broken venue is usually still
29	   broken two hours later and the probe below will catch it, while a
30	   variance trip costs only two hours.
31	2. PROBE. After the cool-off the bot resumes at `resume_frac` (half) size
32	   for `probe_markets` (10) settled markets. `probe_losses` (3) losses in
33	   the probe (~2e-2 under the healthy record) = the breakage was real ->
34	   kill to end of day. A clean probe restores full size.
35	3. DAILY DOLLAR BACKSTOP. `daily_loss_limit` now sits at ~1.5-2 sd of a
36	   coin day ($400): with the streak breaker in front of it, the dollar
37	   stop is the insurance-of-last-resort against slow bleeds the streak
38	   test is blind to (many small losses under high hit rates).
39	
40	State survives restarts: bot/run.py re-seeds day_pnl AND the streak from
41	today's settle lines, so a deploy cannot clear a tripped halt.
42	"""
43	import time
44	from collections import deque
45	
46	
47	def _now_us():
48	    return int(time.time() * 1_000_000)
49	
50	
51	class Risk:
52	    def __init__(self, cfg):
53	        self.max_market_shares = cfg.get("max_market_shares", 200)
54	        self.max_market_dollars = cfg.get("max_market_dollars", 150.0)
55	        self.max_concurrent = cfg.get("max_concurrent_markets", 4)
56	        self.daily_loss_limit = cfg.get("daily_loss_limit", 400.0)
57	        self.stale_binance_s = cfg.get("stale_binance_s", 3.0)
58	        self.stale_oracle_s = cfg.get("stale_oracle_s", 5.0)
59	        self.stale_book_s = cfg.get("stale_book_s", 10.0)
60	        h = cfg.get("halt", {})
61	        self.streak_n = int(h.get("streak_n", 20))
62	        self.streak_losses = int(h.get("streak_losses", 6))
63	        self.cooloff_s = float(h.get("cooloff_s", 7200.0))
64	        self.resume_frac = float(h.get("resume_frac", 0.5))
65	        self.probe_markets = int(h.get("probe_markets", 10))
66	        self.probe_losses = int(h.get("probe_losses", 3))
67	        # UTC, explicitly. Markets, logs and the scorer all live in UTC;
68	        # localtime here would roll the daily loss limit at whatever
69	        # timezone the host happens to be in.
70	        self.day = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.gmtime())
71	        self.day_pnl = 0.0
72	        self.killed = False
73	        self.recent = deque(maxlen=max(self.streak_n, 50))
74	        self.halt_until_us = 0
75	        self.probe_left = 0
76	        self.probe_losses_seen = 0
77	        self.halts = 0
78	
79	    # ---- state helpers --------------------------------------------------
80	    def state_str(self):
81	        if self.killed:
82	            return "KILLED"
83	        if _now_us() < self.halt_until_us:
84	            return f"COOLOFF({max(0, (self.halt_until_us - _now_us()) // 1_000_000)}s)"
85	        if self.probe_left > 0:
86	            return (f"PROBE({self.probe_left} mkts left, "
87	                    f"{self.probe_losses_seen} losses)")
88	        return "NORMAL"
89	
90	    def in_cooloff(self):
91	        if _now_us() < self.halt_until_us:
92	            return True
93	        if self.halt_until_us:
94	            # cool-off just expired: arm the probe exactly once
95	            self.halt_until_us = 0
96	            self.probe_left = self.probe_markets
97	            self.probe_losses_seen = 0
98	        return False
99	
100	    def _roll_day(self):
101	        d = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.gmtime())
102	        if d != self.day:
103	            # A DAILY loss limit must reset daily. Without clearing
104	            # `killed` the first bad day stops the bot permanently and, in
105	            # paper mode, silently ends the measurement run.
106	            self.day = d
107	            self.day_pnl = 0.0
108	            self.killed = False
109	            self.recent.clear()
110	            self.halt_until_us = 0
111	            self.probe_left = 0
112	            self.probe_losses_seen = 0
113	
114	    # ---- events ---------------------------------------------------------
115	    def on_settle_pnl(self, pnl):
116	        """One call per settled market with a position. pnl sign IS the
117	        outcome for a long-only taker: won -> pnl > 0, lost -> pnl < 0."""
118	        self._roll_day()
119	        self.day_pnl += pnl
120	        if pnl == 0:
121	            return
122	        won = pnl > 0
123	        self.recent.append(won)
124	        # probe accounting first: a probe loss counts toward its own bar
125	        if self.probe_left > 0:
126	            self.probe_left -= 1
127	            if not won:
128	                self.probe_losses_seen += 1
129	            if self.probe_losses_seen >= self.probe_losses:
130	                self.killed = True          # breakage confirmed: out for
131	                self.probe_left = 0         # the rest of the UTC day
132	            # a clean probe (probe_left hits 0 first) simply resumes
133	        # streak breaker: losses inside the trailing window
134	        recent = list(self.recent)[-self.streak_n:]
135	        if (len(recent) >= self.streak_n
136	                and sum(1 for w in recent if not w) >= self.streak_losses
137	                and not self.killed
138	                and _now_us() >= self.halt_until_us):
139	            self.halt_until_us = _now_us() + int(self.cooloff_s * 1e6)
140	            self.halts += 1
141	            self.recent.clear()             # the next window starts fresh
142	        # dollar backstop, last
143	        if self.day_pnl < -abs(self.daily_loss_limit):
144	            self.killed = True
145	
146	    def seed(self, day_pnl, outcomes, logged=None):
147	        """Restart persistence: today's realized P&L and settle outcomes
148	        (won bools, oldest first) rebuilt from the decision log, plus the
149	        LAST logged risk-state transition if one exists.
150	
151	        The transition line is authoritative when present: day_pnl alone
152	        cannot distinguish a probe-kill at -$180 from a healthy -$180 day,
153	        and re-inferring the streak from the day's outcomes re-armed a
154	        fresh full cool-off hours after the original had been served.
155	        Without a transition line (first deploy, rotated log) fall back to
156	        conservative inference from the outcomes.
157	        """
158	        self._roll_day()
159	        self.day_pnl = day_pnl
160	        for w in outcomes[-self.recent.maxlen:]:
161	            self.recent.append(bool(w))
162	        if self.day_pnl < -abs(self.daily_loss_limit):
163	            self.killed = True
164	        if logged is not None and logged.get("day") == self.day:
165	            self.killed = self.killed or bool(logged.get("killed"))
166	            hu = int(logged.get("halt_until_us") or 0)
167	            if self.killed:
168	                return
169	            if hu > _now_us():
170	                self.halt_until_us = hu          # honor the ORIGINAL clock
171	                self.halts += 1
172	            elif hu:
173	                # the cool-off elapsed while we were down: probe now
174	                self.probe_left = self.probe_markets
175	                self.probe_losses_seen = 0
176	            else:
177	                self.probe_left = int(logged.get("probe_left") or 0)
178	                self.probe_losses_seen = int(logged.get("probe_losses")
179	                                             or 0)
180	            return
181	        recent = list(self.recent)[-self.streak_n:]
182	        if (len(recent) >= self.streak_n
183	                and sum(1 for w in recent if not w) >= self.streak_losses
184	                and not self.killed):
185	            self.halt_until_us = _now_us() + int(self.cooloff_s * 1e6)
186	            self.halts += 1
187	            self.recent.clear()
188	
189	    # ---- gates ----------------------------------------------------------
190	    def inputs_ok(self, staleness, book_age_s):
191	        """Binance is an ENHANCEMENT, not a requirement.
192	
193	        The oracle is the settlement source and `spot_adj` falls back to it,
194	        so demanding a fresh Binance tick only threw away opportunities --
195	        91% of pre-strategy rejections were Binance staleness caused by a
196	        throttled public mirror, not by anything being wrong.
197	        """
198	        self._roll_day()
199	        return (not self.killed
200	                and not self.in_cooloff()
201	                and staleness["oracle_s"] < self.stale_oracle_s
202	                and book_age_s < self.stale_book_s)
203	
204	    def size_ok(self, current_shares, current_dollars, add_shares, add_px,
205	                n_markets_with_pos):
206	        if self.killed or self.in_cooloff():
207	            return 0.0
208	        if self.probe_left > 0:
209	            add_shares = add_shares * self.resume_frac
210	        if n_markets_with_pos >= self.max_concurrent and current_shares == 0:
211	            return 0.0
212	        room_sh = self.max_market_shares - current_shares
213	        room_usd = self.max_market_dollars - current_dollars
214	        if room_sh <= 0 or room_usd <= 0:
215	            return 0.0
216	        return max(0.0, min(add_shares, room_sh, room_usd / max(add_px, 0.01)))

1	"""Paper broker: simulates maker/taker orders against the live feed with the
2	same conservative fill rules as the backtest.
3	
4	Maker BUY at level L, size Q, posted at t:
5	- a later trade print at price < L on the same asset fills the remainder
6	  (price priority proves the level was swept),
7	- a print exactly at L fills only beyond the displayed queue captured at
8	  post time,
9	- cancel stops all fills.
10	
11	Taker BUY: fills at the current best ask up to its displayed size, pays the
12	0.07*p*(1-p) fee. Never assumes more size than displayed.
13	
14	All orders, fills, and settlements are logged as jsonl for reconciliation
15	against the backtest.
16	"""
17	import json
18	import os
19	import time
20	
21	
22	def now_us():
23	    return int(time.time() * 1_000_000)
24	
25	
26	class PaperBroker:
27	    def __init__(self, log_path="logs/paper_fills.jsonl"):
28	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(log_path), exist_ok=True)
29	        self.log = open(log_path, "a")
30	        self.orders = []          # open maker orders
31	        self.positions = {}       # slug -> {"shares": s, "cost": c}
32	        self.next_id = 1
33	
34	    def _emit(self, kind, **kw):
35	        kw["kind"] = kind
36	        kw["t_us"] = now_us()
37	        self.log.write(json.dumps(kw, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
38	        self.log.flush()
39	
40	    # ---- order entry ---------------------------------------------------
41	    def maker_buy(self, slug, asset_id, side_label, level, size,
42	                  queue_ahead, expire_us, meta=None):
43	        oid = self.next_id
44	        self.next_id += 1
45	        self.orders.append(dict(
46	            oid=oid, slug=slug, asset_id=asset_id, side=side_label,
47	            level=level, size=size, remaining=size, queue=queue_ahead,
48	            expire_us=expire_us))
49	        self._emit("order", oid=oid, slug=slug, side=side_label, level=level,
50	                   size=size, queue=queue_ahead, expire_us=expire_us,
51	                   meta=meta or {})
52	        return oid
53	
54	    def taker_fills(self, slug, side_label, legs, meta=None):
55	        """Book one taker execution made of one or more price legs.
56	
57	        `legs` is [(price, shares)] as produced by the caller walking the
58	        book. Each leg is logged separately so the scorer sees the real
59	        prices paid, not a flattering touch price. Returns total shares.
60	        """
61	        tot = 0.0
62	        for px, sh in legs:
63	            if sh <= 0 or px is None:
64	                continue
65	            fee = 0.07 * px * (1 - px)
66	            pos = self.positions.setdefault(
67	                (slug, side_label), {"shares": 0.0, "cost": 0.0})
68	            pos["shares"] += sh
69	            pos["cost"] += sh * (px + fee)
70	            self._emit("taker_fill", slug=slug, side=side_label, px=px,
71	                       shares=sh, fee_per_sh=fee, meta=meta or {})
72	            tot += sh
73	        return tot
74	
75	    def taker_buy(self, slug, side_label, ask_px, ask_sz, size, meta=None):
76	        """Single-level convenience wrapper (kept for the tests)."""
77	        return self.taker_fills(slug, side_label,
78	                                [(ask_px, min(size, ask_sz))], meta)
79	
80	    def cancel_all(self, slug=None):
81	        for o in self.orders:
82	            if slug is None or o["slug"] == slug:
83	                o["remaining"] = 0
84	        self.orders = [o for o in self.orders if o["remaining"] > 0]
85	
86	    # ---- feed-driven fill simulation ----------------------------------
87	    def on_trade_print(self, asset_id, price, size, t_us):
88	        """Trade prints drive maker fills. Price is in Up-token terms; an
89	        order on side 'Down' at level L maps to Up-print at 1-L."""
90	        for o in self.orders:
91	            if o["remaining"] <= 0 or t_us > o["expire_us"]:
92	                continue
93	            if o["asset_id"] != asset_id:
94	                continue
95	            lvl = o["level"] if o["side"] == "Up" else 1 - o["level"]
96	            hit = price < lvl - 1e-9 if o["side"] == "Up" \
97	                else price > lvl + 1e-9
98	            at = abs(price - lvl) <= 1e-9
99	            fill = 0.0
100	            if hit:
101	                fill = min(o["remaining"], size)
102	            elif at:
103	                beyond = max(0.0, size - o["queue"])
104	                o["queue"] = max(0.0, o["queue"] - size)
105	                fill = min(o["remaining"], beyond)
106	            if fill > 0:
107	                o["remaining"] -= fill
108	                pos = self.positions.setdefault(
109	                    (o["slug"], o["side"]), {"shares": 0.0, "cost": 0.0})
110	                pos["shares"] += fill
111	                pos["cost"] += fill * o["level"]
112	                self._emit("maker_fill", oid=o["oid"], slug=o["slug"],
113	                           side=o["side"], px=o["level"], shares=fill)
114	        self.orders = [o for o in self.orders
115	                       if o["remaining"] > 0 and t_us <= o["expire_us"]]
116	
117	    # ---- settlement ----------------------------------------------------
118	    def settle(self, slug, result):
119	        """result: 0 = Up won, 1 = Down won."""
120	        pnl = 0.0
121	        for (s, side), pos in list(self.positions.items()):
122	            if s != slug or pos["shares"] <= 0:
123	                continue
124	            won = (side == "Up" and result == 0) or \
125	                  (side == "Down" and result == 1)
126	            payoff = pos["shares"] * (1.0 if won else 0.0)
127	            pnl += payoff - pos["cost"]
128	            self._emit("settle", slug=slug, side=side, shares=pos["shares"],
129	                       cost=pos["cost"], payoff=payoff, won=won)
130	            del self.positions[(s, side)]
131	        return pnl

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Restart every coin bot, and PROVE it happened.
3	#
4	# `systemctl restart "jsf-paperbot@*"` matches zero units and exits 0. It
5	# looks like it worked, the && chain continues, and the bots keep running
6	# the old code -- observed live: uptimes of 41,000s straight after a
7	# "successful" restart, which then made a new health field look broken when
8	# it was simply absent. Never trust a glob to a template unit.
9	set -euo pipefail
10	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
11	
12	COINS=$(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(json.load(open('bot/config.json')).get('coins',['btc'])))")
13	UNITS=$(for c in $COINS; do printf 'jsf-paperbot@%s ' "$c"; done)
14	echo "restarting: $UNITS"
15	
16	before=$(for u in $UNITS; do
17	  systemctl show -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic --value "$u" 2>/dev/null
18	done | tr '\n' ' ')
19	
20	# shellcheck disable=SC2086
21	systemctl restart $UNITS
22	# The health loop emits its first line at +5s. Returning before that lets
23	# the caller's status.py read the DEAD process's last health line and
24	# report tens of thousands of seconds of uptime right after a restart that
25	# demonstrably worked.
26	sleep 9
27	
28	fail=0
29	for u in $UNITS; do
30	  up=$(systemctl show -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic --value "$u" 2>/dev/null)
31	  act=$(systemctl is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null || echo inactive)
32	  age=$(( ( $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime | cut -d. -f1) * 1000000 - ${up:-0} ) / 1000000 ))
33	  if [ "$act" != "active" ]; then
34	    echo "  $u: $act  !! NOT RUNNING"; fail=1
35	  elif [ "$age" -gt 60 ]; then
36	    echo "  $u: active but up ${age}s  !! DID NOT RESTART"; fail=1
37	  else
38	    echo "  $u: active, up ${age}s  ok"
39	  fi
40	done
41	echo "(was: $before)"
42	[ "$fail" = 0 ] || { echo "RESTART INCOMPLETE" >&2; exit 5; }
43	echo "all bots restarted"

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# One-shot setup for a fresh Ubuntu droplet. Run as root. Idempotent.
3	#
4	# Installs four units:
5	#   jsf-recorder    live Binance / Chainlink-RTDS / CLOB capture
6	#   jsf-paperbot@X  paper trading on the verified trailing-TWAP contract,
7	#                   one instance per coin in config.json's `coins`
8	#   jsf-prune       hourly: distil endgame books, delete raw (disk guard)
9	#   jsf-edgecheck   daily: frozen-parameter decay monitor
10	#
11	# No API key is required. The whole data pipeline runs on public,
12	# unauthenticated Polymarket and Binance endpoints.
13	set -e
14	
15	REPO_URL="${REPO_URL:-https://github.com/xin10ylop/jsf.git}"
16	BRANCH="${BRANCH:-claude/polymarket-btc-binaries-cy1f9p}"
17	DIR=/opt/jsf
18	
19	apt-get update -y
20	apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip git
21	# chrony separately and non-fatally: this script runs under set -e, and a
22	# clock-daemon hiccup must never abort the deploy half-way -- that leaves
23	# OLD unit files installed while the repo advances, the exact silent
24	# partial-deploy failure this script exists to prevent.
25	apt-get install -y chrony || echo "WARN: chrony install failed; timesyncd stays"
26	
27	# --- clock: the strategy's gate lives in the last 30s and rem enters z as
28	# rem^3, so a couple of seconds of skew systematically misprices every
29	# market. chrony steps the clock hard on boot and keeps it within ms after;
30	# timesyncd (the Ubuntu default) is fine most days but can drift for hours
31	# after a suspend/migration without complaining.
32	systemctl enable --now chrony 2>/dev/null || \
33	  systemctl enable --now chronyd 2>/dev/null || \
34	  echo "WARN: no chrony service; check timedatectl"
35	sleep 2
36	chronyc tracking 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true
37	
38	if [ ! -d $DIR ]; then
39	  git clone --branch "$BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" $DIR
40	else
41	  # Hard-reset to origin. A tracked file edited on the host (probe_latency
42	  # used to write rtt_ms straight into bot/config.json) makes `git pull`
43	  # abort, and the rest of this script then happily "succeeds" against the
44	  # OLD code -- which is how the multi-coin build appeared to deploy and
45	  # did not. Host-specific settings live in bot/config.local.json, which
46	  # is gitignored and survives this.
47	  cd $DIR && git fetch origin "$BRANCH" \
48	    && git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH" \
49	    && git reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH"
50	fi
51	echo "deployed commit: $(cd $DIR && git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
52	cd $DIR
53	pip3 install -r requirements.txt --break-system-packages 2>/dev/null \
54	  || pip3 install -r requirements.txt
55	
56	mkdir -p logs data/live data/live/books reports
57	
58	# --- swap: a 512MB droplet cannot hold two pandas/scipy processes ----------
59	# The recorder and the bot each carry ~150-250 MB RSS once numpy/scipy are
60	# imported, and the daily edge check loads parquet on top of that. Without
61	# swap the box OOMs and drops SSH.
62	# Grow total swap to >= 2G by ADDING a file, never by replacing one.
63	# `swapoff` on a box whose swap is in use forces every swapped-out page
64	# back into RAM at once, and this droplet hosts processes that are not
65	# ours (/opt/polymarketstrat) -- taking swap away could OOM-kill them.
66	# Adding a second file is additive and safe at any moment.
67	if [ ! -f /swapfile ]; then
68	  fallocate -l 2G /swapfile || dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=2048
69	  chmod 600 /swapfile
70	  mkswap /swapfile
71	  swapon /swapfile
72	  grep -q '^/swapfile' /etc/fstab || echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
73	fi
74	SWAP_MB=$(free -m | awk '/^Swap:/{print $2}')
75	if [ "${SWAP_MB:-0}" -lt 2000 ] && [ ! -f /swapfile2 ]; then
76	  echo "swap is ${SWAP_MB}MB; adding /swapfile2 rather than replacing /swapfile"
77	  fallocate -l 2G /swapfile2 || dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile2 bs=1M count=2048
78	  chmod 600 /swapfile2
79	  mkswap /swapfile2
80	  swapon /swapfile2
81	  grep -q '^/swapfile2' /etc/fstab || echo '/swapfile2 none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
82	fi
83	echo 'vm.swappiness=20' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-jsf.conf
84	sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-jsf.conf >/dev/null
85	free -h
86	
87	# Everything JSF runs inside one slice with a hard memory ceiling. This box
88	# may host other people's work (observed: /opt/polymarketstrat), and five
89	# bots plus a recorder measured ~905 MB with the daily edge check pushing
90	# the peak past 1.1 GB -- without a ceiling a leak here takes down a
91	# neighbour we were asked not to touch. MemoryHigh throttles and reclaims
92	# first; MemoryMax is the wall.
93	#
94	# On a 2 GB host this leaves ~500 MB for the OS and anything else running.
95	# Measure the neighbour before trusting that:
96	#   systemd-cgtop -b -n1 --order=memory | head
97	# and lower these if it needs more. Nothing in JSF is OOM-protected any
98	# more -- OOMScoreAdjust=-500 used to make the kernel prefer to kill
99	# something else, which is the wrong default on a shared box.
100	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf.slice <<'UNIT'
101	[Unit]
102	Description=JSF bots and recorder, memory-bounded as a group
103	
104	[Slice]
105	MemoryHigh=700M
106	MemoryMax=900M
107	UNIT
108	
109	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-recorder.service <<'UNIT'
110	[Unit]
111	Description=JSF live data recorder (Binance / Chainlink RTDS / Polymarket CLOB)
112	After=network-online.target
113	Wants=network-online.target
114	
115	[Service]
116	WorkingDirectory=/opt/jsf
117	ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 bot/recorder.py
118	Slice=jsf.slice
119	Restart=always
120	RestartSec=5
121	
122	[Install]
123	WantedBy=multi-user.target
124	UNIT
125	
126	# One bot process per coin: BotState carries a single oracle buffer and vol
127	# estimator, so the coin is a property of the process. ~46 MB RSS each.
128	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-paperbot@.service <<'UNIT'
129	[Unit]
130	Description=JSF paper bot for %i (endgame taker, trailing-TWAP contract)
131	After=network-online.target
132	Wants=network-online.target
133	
134	[Service]
135	WorkingDirectory=/opt/jsf
136	ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 bot/run.py --coin %i
137	Slice=jsf.slice
138	Restart=always
139	RestartSec=5
140	
141	[Install]
142	WantedBy=multi-user.target
143	UNIT
144	
145	# The pre-multi-coin single unit, if present, would run a second btc bot
146	# against the same logs/btc/bot.lock and flap on the lock forever.
147	if systemctl list-unit-files | grep -q '^jsf-paperbot\.service'; then
148	  systemctl disable --now jsf-paperbot.service 2>/dev/null || true
149	  rm -f /etc/systemd/system/jsf-paperbot.service
150	fi
151	
152	COINS=$(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(json.load(open('/opt/jsf/bot/config.json')).get('coins',['btc'])))")
153	BOT_UNITS=$(for c in $COINS; do printf 'jsf-paperbot@%s ' "$c"; done)
154	echo "bot units: $BOT_UNITS"
155	
156	# --- disk guard: the recorder writes ~6.5 GB/day of raw book JSONL ---------
157	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-prune.service <<'UNIT'
158	[Unit]
159	Description=JSF book pruner (distil endgame snapshots, reclaim disk)
160	
161	[Service]
162	Type=oneshot
163	WorkingDirectory=/opt/jsf
164	Slice=jsf.slice
165	ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 bot/prune.py --window 90 --keep-raw-hours 1
166	# Retention for the tick captures the pruner does not distil. The oracle
167	# capture (rtds) feeds tape_chainlink and the bots' restart backfill; a
168	# week is plenty for both, and unbounded it eventually eats the disk.
169	ExecStart=/usr/bin/find /opt/jsf/data/live/rtds -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +7 -delete
170	ExecStart=/usr/bin/find /opt/jsf/data/live/binance -name '*.jsonl' -mtime +7 -delete
171	UNIT
172	
173	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-prune.timer <<'UNIT'
174	[Unit]
175	Description=Run the JSF book pruner every 20 minutes
176	
177	[Timer]
178	OnCalendar=*:00/20
179	Persistent=true
180	
181	[Install]
182	WantedBy=timers.target
183	UNIT
184	
185	# --- decay monitor: frozen parameters, appends reports/decay_log.csv -------
186	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-edgecheck.service <<'UNIT'
187	[Unit]
188	Description=JSF daily edge / decay check
189	
190	[Service]
191	Type=oneshot
192	WorkingDirectory=/opt/jsf
193	MemoryMax=600M
194	Nice=10
195	# NOT in jsf.slice: its 600M allowance on top of the bots pushed the
196	# slice past MemoryMax=900M at 02:30 UTC daily -- cgroup reclaim stalls
197	# every bot's event loop mid-settle-window, or the OOM killer takes one.
198	ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 src/daily_edge_check.py
199	# The self-sufficient decay row: daily_edge_check's kline zips end at
200	# 2026-08-09 and it silently stopped appending. The hybrid tape fetches
201	# everything itself and measures the edge on the CORRECT input series.
202	ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u src/tape_chainlink.py --hours 24 --picks first --csv reports/hybrid_decay.csv
203	UNIT
204	
205	cat > /etc/systemd/system/jsf-edgecheck.timer <<'UNIT'
206	[Unit]
207	Description=Run the JSF edge check daily
208	
209	[Timer]
210	OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:30:00 UTC
211	Persistent=true
212	
213	[Install]
214	WantedBy=timers.target
215	UNIT
216	
217	systemctl daemon-reload
218	systemctl start jsf.slice 2>/dev/null || true
219	# shellcheck disable=SC2086
220	systemctl enable --now jsf-recorder $BOT_UNITS jsf-prune.timer jsf-edgecheck.timer
221	sleep 3
222	systemctl --no-pager --plain status jsf-recorder | head -4
223	for u in $BOT_UNITS; do systemctl --no-pager --plain status "$u" | head -3; done
224	free -m | head -2
225	echo "jsf.slice ceiling: $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/jsf.slice/memory.max 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
226	systemctl --no-pager list-timers 'jsf-*' || true
227	cat <<'MSG'

229	DONE.

235	  ex-ante depth    cd /opt/jsf && PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/depth_sim.py
